proposals.evidence: DEDR 4096 gives Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada pāl, Telugu pālu, Parji pēl, Tulu pēru and Gondi pāl ‘milk’. The milk gloss distinguishes this family from pal ‘tooth’, even where survey length is unmarked. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
